process.amend: branch + pull request; merge requires approval from the other player
process.ratify: each player flips their own ready_to_play flag via PR, approved by the other
process.lock: when both flags are true, tag the commit game-<n>-locked; locked=true; no rule changes for that game
process.post_game: proposals go to RETROSPECTIVE.md; applied via PRs; version bumped; flags reset to false
